description: Predict entity trajectory, test for AABB obstacle collisions, or compute navigation waypoints (modes: simulate, navigate, waypoints). Read-only simulation. Returns {ok, is_valid, destination, collisions[], waypoints[]}. Use simulate_movement instead of record_outcome when testing hypothetical motion and collisions before executing an action.

check_collisions.description: Whether to test for AABB obstacle collisions (default: true)

entity_id.description: Entity ID to simulate or move

mode.description: Operation mode: "simulate" (default) for physics/collision, "navigate" or "waypoints" for path planning

start_entity_id.description: Starting entity ID for navigation mode

target_entity_id.description: Target destination entity ID for navigation mode

velocity.description: Velocity vector in units per second

name: simulate_movement
